name: codex-cost-orchestrator
description: Fast role-aware Codex orchestration with thin skills, static native Agent routing, and exact-state acceptance evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Static native Agent routes with exact-state acceptance.
interface.longDescription: Codex Cost Orchestrator is a thin local control plane for Codex native Agents. Primary submits one closed logical plan; CCO derives dependency-ready waves, maximum non-conflicting work, strict direct-dependency owner reuse, safe mechanical aggregation, current model and effort routes, exact workspace baselines, cross-task reader/writer admission, continuation cursors, restart fencing, and acceptance-ID evidence. The network-free default prefers Luna for mechanical work, Terra for bounded or guarded work and review, and never selects Sol without a current explicit user pin. Codex remains the only Agent runtime, while Primary keeps intent, integration, and final acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Implement and verify this feature with CCO's default static route.
Inspect this system through a closed CCO explorer contract.
Review this exact state through an independent CCO reviewer.
